verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions official end-to-end testing tools, such as a Playwright integration or an E2E add-on, or any testing setup that works with the Vite-based dev server. `sv add` is documented only generically as adding 'new functionality', without naming any testing tool. Testing tooling is a fair axis for a UI framework, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate official end-to-end testing tools that work out of the box with the framework's dev server
